page.overview:
Who is Agent Burke?

Agent Burke is a man full of secrets and a G.I. Joe employee with an interest in alien technology. If you're looking for a job and you've saved the world, he'll invite you to see his tank collection.

He was portrayed by Michael Kelly and appears in a post-credits scene in Transformers: Rise of the Beasts. Category:Movie characters Category:Transformers: Rise Of The Beasts Characters Category:G.I. Joe Team
